title: rosa sepium subsp. klukii
intro: Rosa sepium subsp. klukii, commonly known as Korean rose or Rosa acicularis, is a subspecies of the Rosa sepium species, native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Rosa sepium subsp. klukii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardioprotective effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
